snippet.title: Gear Up Einstein! - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950410/Gear_Up_Einstein

Recruit historical figures and turn them into badass soldiers to save the world. With up to 2 friends, travel across history, find ridiculous combos and master tactical battles in this over-the-top roguelite.

Follow us for more and enjoy !

Discord: https://discord.gg/zxaeF2CJKb
